metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the three breaths, the foot of the page, and a fish-day board you ate.

yesterday: York short, Gaunt long, the King never out. The foot of the page is empty.
You ate. The board was threepence. The loaf was a finger and a half, at a penny. The firing sixpence stayed off the slate.
Verbeke went to his own work under his own name. The one bough is still the allowance.
You have not told Mistress Ansell about Sunday. Kemp has still not seen the king's page.
Edmund is fifteen tomorrow. You have not written the letter.
